plan.summary: FEAT-INMA-PIPELINE-V2 C3a (backend-only): a new 'customer_status_changed' flow trigger. When C2 APPLIES a customer_status change (StoredApplied), Backend captures each affected lead's old→new status atomically, fires ONLY for leads whose status actually changed (old IS DISTINCT FROM new), applies a fail-closed loop-guard, and enqueues one Automation Hangfire job per changed lead. The job resolves the tenant's customer_status_changed flow(s) with most-specific-wins featureGroupId matching and runs FlowEngineV2 with the change context. C3b (Flow Builder UI node + cxapi catalog) and C4 (Set Customer Status write-back) are deferred.
plan.q_intent: Resume FEAT-INMA-PIPELINE-V2: start C3 — Flow Builder customer_status_changed trigger (C2 already persists actor_type + origin_request_id for suppression).
plan.interview_notes: Q AskUserQuestion 4/4: split C3a backend / C3b UI; extend C2 repo for per-lead old→new context (1 flow per lead); match on featureGroupId only; hardcode suppression defaults. Codex critique (gpt-5.5, mode=critique) hardened the plan and I ADOPTED: (1) CTE FOR UPDATE+MATERIALIZED+ORDER BY id+tenant_id-in-UPDATE to keep C2's monotonic guard under concurrency; (2) enqueue ONLY when old_status IS DISTINCT FROM new_status (a re-selection to the same opaque status must not fire a fake trigger); (3) loop guard FAILS CLOSED — fire only on actor.type=='user', suppress api/zoho-webhook/system/null/unknown; (4) most-specific-wins featureGroupId matching (no catch-all double-fire); (5) structured observability. Q reliability decision: AutomaticRetry=0, NO dedupe table (matches shipped TriggerWelcomeFlowJob/CronSchedulerJob; replay already deduped upstream by C2; bounded-retry+idempotency = recorded hardening backlog before real-flow go-live). Self-decided defaults: queue='automation'; synthetic chat_id range -4_000_000; fire on StoredApplied only; fire-and-forget enqueue (log+200); INV-INM-008 (Backend enqueue) + INV-AT-088 (Automation job).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: FlowGraphV2.TriggerTypes includes 'customer_status_changed' so a v2 flow whose entry node is that type resolves graph.TriggerStart (non-null); FlowValidator.RequiredFields gains ['customer_status_changed'] = ['label'].

New CustomerStatusChangedTriggerHandler : INodeHandler (NodeType='customer_status_changed') registered as Singleton in Automation DI; maps the seeded __-prefixed session variables to the contract flow vars {{customer_status_group}}, {{old_customer_status}}, {{new_customer_status}}, {{customer_status_changed_by}}; returns Action=Continue, MessageText=null (pure — no DB/HTTP/WA send).

InmaWebhookEventRepository apply step becomes a single CTE+UPDATE: WITH affected AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id, customer_status AS old_status FROM leads WHERE <tenant + phone match + monotonic guard> ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE) UPDATE leads l SET customer_status=@status, customer_status_occurred_at=COALESCE(@occ,l...) FROM affected a WHERE l.id=a.id AND l.tenant_id=@tid RETURNING l.id, a.old_status, l.customer_status AS new_status. Result struct gains AppliedLeads (List<AppliedLead{LeadId, OldStatus, NewStatus}>); MatchedLeadCount == rows updated == AppliedLeads.Count; duplicate/phone-unmatched/stale-skip return empty list. C2 HMAC/dedupe/audit/guard logic otherwise untouched.

Backend HandleCustomerSelectionChangedAsync, ONLY in StoredApplied: evaluate shared static CustomerStatusFlowSuppression.Evaluate(actorType, originRequestId) → {Fire | SuppressLoop | SuppressActor}. Suppress (no enqueue) if originRequestId starts with shared const 'invekto-' OR actorType != 'user' (api/zoho-webhook/system/null/unknown all suppressed — FAIL CLOSED). When Fire: enqueue one TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob per AppliedLead WHERE OldStatus IS DISTINCT FROM NewStatus, via IBackgroundJobClient from ctx.RequestServices. Enqueue wrapped in typed catches (BackgroundJobClientException/NpgsqlException/InvalidOperationException) → INV-INM-008 WARN, still HTTP 200. Log an anomaly WARN when an event has an 'invekto-' originRequestId but actor != 'api' (INMA echo weirdness detector). Stale/duplicate/phone-unmatched never enqueue.

TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob ([Queue('automation')], [AutomaticRetry(Attempts=0)]) resolves the tenant's active v2 customer_status_changed flows via NEW tenant-scoped AutomationRepository.GetActiveCustomerStatusFlowsAsync (WHERE tenant_id=@tid AND is_active AND flow_config->>'version'='2' AND EXISTS node type='customer_status_changed'). Reads feature_group_id from graph.TriggerStart (the single trigger node; FlowGraphV2 + UI maxInstances:1 guarantee one). MOST-SPECIFIC-WINS: if any flow's trigger feature_group_id equals the event featureGroupId, run only those; else run catch-all flows (empty/null node feature_group_id). event.featureGroupId null (text mode) → only catch-all matches. Per matched flow: synthetic session (chat_id range -4_000_000), seed 4 __-prefixed vars into SessionStateV2.Variables, FlowEngineV2.ExecuteAsync, EndSession. No matching flow = benign info no-op. Failures (Npgsql/OperationCanceled/InvalidOperation, FlowGraphV2.Build null) → INV-AT-088, no retry, session closed 'error'.

Loop-guard provably breaks C2→C3→(C4)→C2: an event echoing our future C4 write (originRequestId='invekto-{flowRunUuid}', actor 'api') is suppressed at dispatch BOTH by the prefix AND by the fire-only-on-'user' rule — and a missing/truncated echo (actor api/system/null) is still suppressed (fail-closed). The 'invekto-' prefix is a SINGLE shared constant (Invekto.Shared) reused by C4 — no duplicate literal.

No DB migration (leads.customer_status + customer_status_occurred_at exist from Migration 065); no frontend/TS changes (C3b). The Shared edit (suppression static + prefix const + new codes) triggers a full-solution build + microservice-isolation check; build PASS, 0 errors.

Change-detection gate verified end-to-end: an event that re-applies the SAME derived opaque status to a lead (occurred_at advances, status unchanged) is counted in MatchedLeadCount but its AppliedLead has OldStatus == NewStatus → NO job enqueued for it (no fake trigger). Only genuine status transitions fire.

Structured logs at dispatch (eventId, tenantId, matchedLeadCount, changedLeadCount, suppress decision+reason, enqueuedCount) and in the job (matched flow count, specific-vs-catchall, per-flow fire/skip, execution status). A 'why didn't my flow fire' question is answerable from logs alone.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: AutomaticRetry=0 on TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob; NO durable trigger-dedupe table in C3a.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Event-replay/redelivery double-fire is prevented UPSTREAM by C2's dedupe(tenant_id,event_id) — C3 runs only on a freshly-inserted StoredApplied event, never a duplicate. With no Hangfire retry there is no retry-duplicate vector, so no dedupe table is needed. Matches the shipped TriggerWelcomeFlowJob/CronSchedulerJob posture. Real flows are not live yet (C3b deferred); Q-approved MVP tradeoff.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: do NOT FAIL for 'AutomaticRetry=0 without idempotency table'. Replay dedupe is upstream (C2); no retry => no duplicate vector. Bounded-retry+idempotency is a recorded hardening backlog item, not a C3a blocker.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Enqueue happens AFTER C2's transaction commits (PersistAndApplyAsync commits internally before returning); no same-tx enqueue, no transactional outbox.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Enqueue-after-commit prevents fire-on-rollback and stale reads. The residual crash-window (commit succeeds, process dies before enqueue) loses at most one trigger and matches the shipped LeadIntakeService→TriggerWelcomeFlowJob pattern.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: do NOT FAIL for 'no transactional outbox'. Enqueue is strictly post-commit; residual loss-window is the accepted platform posture (LIW precedent).

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: One Hangfire job per CHANGED lead (per-lead fan-out), gated on OldStatus IS DISTINCT FROM NewStatus.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q decision: per-lead context. Change-gate stops fake triggers from a same-status re-selection. Distinct lead ids come from UPDATE...RETURNING (each row once) so a lead matched by two phones is not enqueued twice.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: per-lead fanout is intentional. One-phone→N-leads customer-level duplicate-message risk is documented; channel-level dedup is out of C3a scope.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Loop guard fails CLOSED: fire only on actor.type=='user'; suppress api/zoho-webhook/system/null/unknown + any 'invekto-' originRequestId prefix.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Loop safety dominates: if a future C4 write-back's originRequestId echo is missing/truncated, actor=='api' (and null) still suppress. INMA contract populates actor.type='user' for human panel changes (the intended trigger).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: firing only on 'user' is a deliberate fail-closed loop guard, not a missed-case bug. 'invekto-' prefix is a shared Invekto.Shared constant reused by C4.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Synthetic chat_session mirrors the shipped TriggerWelcomeFlowJob/CronSchedulerJob exactly (CreateSessionAsync phone:null, currentNode 'v2_active', negative chat_id range -4_000_000).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Proven production pattern for non-message flow dispatch; message-delivery semantics for synthetic-session flows are inherited unchanged (C3a adds no new send path).
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: synthetic session is the established welcome/cron pattern, not an ad-hoc invention.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Tenant-scoped flow resolution (GetActiveCustomerStatusFlowsAsync WHERE tenant_id=@tid first), NOT the cron's cross-tenant scan.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: C3 dispatch is caused by ONE tenant's event; tenant-first predicate then JSONB EXISTS only within that tenant's flows.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: CQ9 tenant-isolation PASS — request-path query is tenant-scoped. The cross-tenant precedent (GetActiveScheduleFlowsAsync) is a background SWEEP, deliberately NOT mirrored here.

verification_questions.question: Does the CTE+UPDATE with MATERIALIZED + FOR UPDATE + ORDER BY id capture each lead's PRE-update customer_status atomically (one statement/snapshot, rows locked before action, no TOCTOU) AND preserve C2's monotonic guard so an older-occurredAt event cannot overwrite newer state, while MatchedLeadCount stays equal to rows updated?

Is the enqueue reached ONLY on StoredApplied (never StoredStaleSkipped/StoredPhoneUnmatched/DuplicateSameBody/DuplicateDivergentBody), only for leads where OldStatus IS DISTINCT FROM NewStatus, and is it fire-and-forget so a Hangfire/Npgsql/InvalidOperation failure is caught+logged (INV-INM-008) WITHOUT changing the HTTP 200 — so INMA's at-least-once retry never re-applies?

Does the fail-closed suppression provably break the C2→C3→C4→C2 loop — fire only on actor.type=='user', suppress api/zoho-webhook/system/null/unknown AND any 'invekto-' originRequestId — with the prefix as a single shared Invekto.Shared constant (no duplicate literal) so C3 and the future C4 cannot drift?

Is GetActiveCustomerStatusFlowsAsync tenant-scoped (tenant_id leading predicate) so the job only resolves/executes flows of the triggering event's tenant (no cross-tenant execution), and is feature_group_id read from graph.TriggerStart (this flow's own trigger node), with most-specific-wins so a catch-all flow does not double-fire alongside a specific one?

Idempotency posture: event-replay deduped upstream by C2(tenant_id,event_id); change-gate (old≠new) prevents fake fires; AutomaticRetry=0 (Q decision, matches welcome/cron) => no retry-duplicate vector; commit-before-enqueue residual crash-window accepted (LIW precedent). Bounded-retry+dedupe-table+outbox = named hardening backlog before real-flow go-live.

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Enqueue and job execution are fire-and-forget but NOT silent: enqueue failures log INV-INM-008 (WARN), job execution failures log INV-AT-088, and fire/suppress(reason)/changedLeadCount/matched-flow-count are all logged. 'No customer_status_changed flow configured' is a legitimate info no-op. The change-gate prevents fake fires. C2 commits before any of this, so the worst case is an observable missed/dropped trigger on a transient blip (accepted MVP tradeoff, AutomaticRetry=0) — never silent data loss, double-apply, or a loop.

aha_moments.user_pain: A status→action automation (C4) could re-trigger itself forever, hammering INMA and re-running flows.
aha_moments.suggestion: Fail-closed loop guard: fire only on a human 'user' actor and suppress any 'invekto-' originRequestId, via a single shared constant reused by C4.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A clinic builds a status-driven automation that itself sets a status and it just works once per real human change — no runaway loop, no incident.

aha_moments.user_pain: A clinic agent moves a patient to 'Uçak Bileti' in INMA but must manually remember to send the travel-info WhatsApp.
aha_moments.suggestion: Fire the matching customer_status_changed flow the instant C2 applies the change.
aha_moments.aha_moment: The agent changes the status and the follow-up is already on its way — zero extra clicks.

aha_moments.user_pain: Re-saving the same status (no real change) would spam a fake 'status changed' automation.
aha_moments.suggestion: Capture old→new per lead and only fire where old IS DISTINCT FROM new.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Agents can click around without fear — only genuine status transitions ever trigger a flow.

aha_moments.user_pain: 'Why didn't my status-change flow fire?' is unanswerable if dispatch decisions are invisible.
aha_moments.suggestion: Log fire / suppress(reason) / changedLeadCount / matched-flow-count / per-flow result with tenant+lead+status.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support reads one log line and sees instantly whether it was suppressed, unmatched, unchanged, or a real failure.

aha_moments.user_pain: Non-technical clinics can't script 'when status becomes X, do Y' without engineering.
aha_moments.suggestion: Make customer_status_changed a first-class flow trigger (plumbing here; the visual node lands in C3b).
aha_moments.aha_moment: A clinic drags a 'Müşteri Durumu Değişti' trigger onto the canvas and wires its own automation — no dev needed.

Q1.reasoning: CTE MATERIALIZED+FOR UPDATE+ORDER BY id captures pre-update status atomically, preserves monotonic guard, MatchedLeadCount==rows updated.

Q2.reasoning: Enqueue only on StoredApplied + only changed leads; typed-catch INV-INM-008, HTTP 200 preserved.

Q3.reasoning: Fail-closed suppress (fire only on user; invekto- prefix loop kill) via single shared constant; 18-case test covers it.

Q4.reasoning: GetActiveCustomerStatusFlowsAsync tenant_id-leading; feature_group_id from graph.TriggerStart; most-specific-wins prevents catch-all double-fire.
